title.zh: 手机版收起来了：一套界面走三端，渲染能跑无头
title.en: The phone version is gone: one interface for every surface, and renders that run headless

highlights.zh: 手机外壳砍除：手机与平板浏览器拿到与桌面相同的一套界面。
highlights.en: The phone shell is gone, and a phone or tablet browser gets the same interface the desktop does.

highlights.zh: 渲染可在 Node 里跑、不经浏览器；MCP 四个渲染工具多了 headless。
highlights.en: A render can run in Node without a browser, and the four MCP render tools take a headless option.

highlights.zh: 通道条压缩器改用本项目 worklet，两个宿主的差距收窄。
highlights.en: Every channel strip compressor is the project's own worklet now, which narrows the gap between the two hosts.

highlights.zh: 编排在浅色皮肤下可读：探针新增进入编辑器的视图，抓到琴键底色只有 3.4:1。
highlights.en: The arrangement reads in the light skins: a new probe view enters the editor and caught a key bed at 3.4:1.

highlights.zh: 文档：删 3 份、23 份标注为历史、其余就地更正。
highlights.en: Documentation: three documents deleted, twenty-three marked as history, the rest corrected in place.

title.zh: 编排像 DAW，谱面与 MIDI 互通
title.en: An arrangement that reads like a DAW, and notation that interoperates

highlights.zh: 编排界面按业界惯例重做：工具栏、轨道头列、标尺、播放头与循环区间。
highlights.en: The arrangement is rebuilt on the conventions: a toolbar, a track-header column, a ruler, a playhead and a loop brace.

highlights.zh: 按播放真的出声：编排走引擎音序器，采样轨逐步触发。
highlights.en: Play actually sounds now: the arrangement drives the engine's sequencer, and a sampler lane triggers step by step.

highlights.zh: 谱面页签，以及 MusicXML 的导入导出。
highlights.en: A score tab, and MusicXML in both directions.

highlights.zh: 选乐器改成乐器库：搜索、分类、大分类下再分一级。
highlights.en: Choosing an instrument is a library: search, categories, and a second level when a category is long.

highlights.zh: 采样器更贴文件意图：敲一下鼓不再被截断，闭镲会掐断开镲。
highlights.en: Samplers follow the file more closely: a drum hit is no longer cut short, and a closed hat chokes an open one.

highlights.zh: 中文 MIDI 轨道名（UTF-8 与 GBK）不再乱码。
highlights.en: Chinese track names in MIDI files (UTF-8 and GBK) are no longer mojibake.

title.zh: 采样器按文件真实意图演奏
title.en: Samplers play what the file actually says

highlights.zh: 文件用控制器关掉的音区不再发声，之前会照弹。
highlights.en: A region the file switches off with a controller no longer sounds; before it played anyway.

highlights.zh: 控制器的曲线 1 是双极的：整套鼓之前高一个八度，现在不会了。
highlights.en: Controller curve 1 is bipolar: the drum kit was an octave sharp, and is not now.

highlights.zh: 新建编排里可以试听采样器：点琴键或敲电脑键盘。
highlights.en: A keyboard in the new arrangement: click the keys or use the computer keyboard to hear a sampler.

highlights.zh: 钢琴卷帘：点格子写音符，长度与力度在上方可调。
highlights.en: A piano roll: click a cell to write a note, with its length and velocity set above.

title.zh: VCSL 四族与全部程序都进来了
title.en: VCSL's four families, and every program

highlights.zh: VCSL 的四个族已镜像：2651 个文件、2488 段实测，声明 88 件乐器。
highlights.en: VCSL's four families are mirrored: 2651 files, 2488 measured, 88 instruments declared.

highlights.zh: Karoryfer 两件不再只给一件乐器：贝斯声明 39 件，吉他 6 件。
highlights.en: The two Karoryfer libraries no longer offer one instrument each: the bass declares 39, the guitar 6.

highlights.zh: 取树时只取需要的路径，5.74 GB 的库不必整棵下载。
highlights.en: A pinned tree is fetched by path, so a 5.74 GB library need not be downloaded whole.

highlights.zh: 新建路线有了自己的音频引擎，不再是空壳，按播放会出声。
highlights.en: The new-project route has its own audio engine, so it is no longer a shell and Play makes a sound.

highlights.zh: 采样轨道可以挑乐器，四件真实乐器里选一件。
highlights.en: A sampler track can choose its instrument, from the four real libraries.

highlights.zh: 每条轨道的十六步看得见，也能点。
highlights.en: Each track's sixteen steps are visible and tappable.

highlights.zh: 录完的音会落到轨道上，take 列表不再是空的。
highlights.en: A recording reaches its track, so the take list is no longer empty.

title.zh: 关于里能联系到我们了
title.en: The About panel can reach us now

highlights.zh: 设置里的关于新增两行：联系地址，以及发邮件上报问题。
highlights.en: The About panel in settings has two new rows: the contact address, and a line to report a bug by email.

highlights.zh: 上报那条带着主题，于是来信是标好的，而不是一句无题的问候。
highlights.en: The bug line carries a subject, so a report arrives labelled rather than as a bare greeting.

title.zh: 四件真实乐器都已就位
title.en: Four real instruments, all in place

highlights.zh: 电贝斯与电吉他加入：Karoryfer 的两件免费乐器已镜像，各自带 587 与 331 个文件。
highlights.en: Electric bass and electric guitar join: two Karoryfer instruments are mirrored, with 587 and 331 files.

highlights.zh: 清单现在逐个文件带哈希，并带实测时长——四件乐器共 3244 个文件，全部核对过。
highlights.en: The manifest now carries a hash per file and a measured duration — 3244 files across four instruments, all verified.

highlights.zh: 可达性检查会遍历每一个乐器，而不是只看第一个。
highlights.en: The reachability check walks every instrument rather than only the first.

title.zh: 第一件真实乐器能出声了
title.en: The first real instrument can sound

highlights.zh: SFZ 引擎学会了 #define 变量（键与值都插值）与 default_path，于是真实的采样乐器不再静音。
highlights.en: The SFZ engine learned #define variables in keys as well as values, and default_path, so real sampled instruments are no longer silent.

highlights.zh: 萨拉曼德大钢琴已镜像到 R2：668 个文件、641 段时长实测，公网可达且字节相符。
highlights.en: Salamander Grand Piano is mirrored to R2: 668 files, 641 durations measured, publicly reachable with bytes matching.

highlights.zh: 镜像从此有脚本：清单生成器、预算检查、上传与可达性核对。
highlights.en: Mirroring now has scripts: a manifest builder, a budget check, an uploader and a reachability check.

title.zh: 顶部导航加了新建入口
title.en: A New entry in the top navigation

highlights.zh: 顶部导航里多了一个新建，直接进入新编排 /new。
highlights.en: The top navigation now has a New entry that opens the new arrangement at /new.

highlights.zh: 它是一个链接而不是标签页：新项目是一条自己的路由，不必成为第十四个导航词。
highlights.en: It is a link rather than a tab: a new project is a route of its own and need not become a fourteenth nav word.

highlights.zh: 手机底部导航的入口还在做。
highlights.en: The mobile bottom bar entry is still to come.

title.zh: 新编排界面用上了应用的样式
title.en: The new arrangement interface uses the app's styling

highlights.zh: 此前的 /new 是一堆没有样式的文字：组件一个类都没用，而应用是用工具类与设计令牌画的。
highlights.en: Until now /new was a wall of unstyled text: the components used no classes, while the app is drawn with utilities and tokens.

highlights.zh: 现在卡片、轨道行、take 选择器、录音按钮都使用应用已有的词汇，不新造一套。
highlights.en: Cards, track rows, the take selector and the record button now use the app's existing vocabulary rather than a new one.

highlights.zh: 而原有三层检查都是绿的，所以还补一个「新组件必须用到样式」的检查。
highlights.en: All three existing checks were green, so a check of the missing kind is added: a new component must use styling.
